description: Update the project README.md to document the new Profile Management feature including avatar upload, email change, and password change capabilities.
steps: 1. Add a new section to README.md (after the 'Implementation Status' section or within the feature table) documenting: (a) Profile Management feature overview. (b) Avatar Upload: supports JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP up to 5MB, stored as base64 in MongoDB, displayed in navbar and profile page. (c) Email Change: requires current password verification, validates format and uniqueness. (d) Password Change: enforces complexity (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character). (e) API endpoints: GET /api/profile, PUT /api/profile, PUT /api/profile/email, PUT /api/profile/password, POST /api/profile/avatar.
2. Update the Implementation Status table to mark 'Profile Management - avatar upload, email change, password change' as Done.
acceptance_criteria: README.md contains documentation about the Profile Management feature
The new API endpoints are listed in the README
The Implementation Status table is updated
verification: Read README.md and verify the new section exists with correct information
findings: Documentation-only change. Added Profile Management section after Implementation Status with details on avatar upload, email change, password change, and API endpoints. Updated the status table with a new row.
